G1722.kjv_def: about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (... sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in (-to, -wardly), X mightily, ! (because) of, (up-)on, [open-]ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, [speedi-]ly, X that, X there (-in, -on), through (-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where (-with), while, with (-in).

G746.strongs_def: a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank)
G746.kjv_def: beginning, corner, (at the, the) first (estate), magistrate, power, principality, principle, rule.

G2258.strongs_def: I (thou, etc.) was (the more or less emphatic or rather irregular imperfect of G1510)
G2258.kjv_def: + agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.

G3588.strongs_def: the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom)
G3588.kjv_def: the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.

G3056.strongs_def: something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ)
G3056.kjv_def: account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work.

G2532.strongs_def: and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or as addition) with other particles or small words
G2532.kjv_def: and, also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yet.

G4314.strongs_def: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)
G4314.kjv_def: about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, ([where-])by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with (-in).

G2316.strongs_def: a deity, especially (with G3588) the supreme Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very
